what: Vertical cards stick one after another 50px from the top of the screen. While the next card rises from 419px to 50px from the top, the previous card sinks one step. For k cards in between: scale 1 − .05k (down to .85), opacity 1 − .25k (down to .25), up 50k px, blur 2k px (up to 6). No curve, tied to scroll (scrub). The later a card sticks, the smaller and blurrier the earlier cards pile up in layers

options.from: A card behind starts sinking when it reaches this position (px), default 419
options.scale: Shrink per step, default .05 · scale-min default .85
options.fade: Fade per step, default .25 · fade-min default .25
options.blur: Blur per cell (px), default 2 — 0 turns it off (original phone) · blur-max default 6
options.base: Reads values as px at this width and scales with window width (.64~1.6x) — original 1600, default 0 (px as they are)

from.where: index.html schedule session card (original Md — 50·419·.05·.25·50·2·6, no blur on phones)
